sources: Google Maps listing 'Hickory Creek RV Park', 318 Washington Ave, Neosho (4.1 stars, 60 reviews), read 2026-11-07

values.note: City of Neosho: $25 a night including electricity, water and the dump station; 3% convenience fee on card payments. Changes or cancellations at least 48 hours ahead ($10 cancellation fee); no refunds inside 48 hours.

fees.source: https://www.neoshomo.gov/413/Hickory-Creek-RV-Park ('$25.00 per night which includes electricity, water, and sewer dump station. A 3% convience fee will be added to all card transactions'; cancellation terms), read 2026-11-07

hookups.source: https://www.neoshomo.gov/413/Hickory-Creek-RV-Park ('RV Spots have 50 & 30 amp'; the fee covers 'electricity, water, and sewer dump station' - a dump station, not sewer at the site; 'Draining of waste water or grey water on ground is prohibited'), read 2026-11-07. The derived sewer: true from the old note's 'full-hookup' is cleared; water left as recorded.

values.note: Dump station open 7 am-3 pm Monday-Friday year-round and 7-9 am Saturday-Sunday March-October.

facilities.source: https://www.neoshomo.gov/413/Hickory-Creek-RV-Park ('Dump station is open from 7am-3pm, Monday- Friday (Year-Round) and 7am-9am, Saturday-Sunday (March-October)'), read 2026-11-07

values.note: Book and pay at Neosho City Hall, by email or through the city's online reservation form; no RV may camp without a City Hall payment receipt. Sites are self-picked first-come on arrival. A stay booked after hours or on a weekend dry-camps until staff assign a spot and unlock the hookups the next business day. Check-out 11 am; no RV left unattended over 72 hours.

booking.source: https://www.neoshomo.gov/413/Hickory-Creek-RV-Park ('Reservations can be done in person at Neosho City Hall, by email or online'; 'No RV Camping is allowed without a receipt of payment from City Hall'; 'Sites are self-picked on a first come/first serve basis upon arrival'; 'Maximum seven (7) night stay'; 'CHECK OUT TIME IS 11 A.M.'; after-hours dry-camp line; reservation form link), read 2026-11-07

note: City of Neosho RV park in Morse Park near Hickory Creek; RV parking only, no tents. --Claude
summary: City page: $25 confirmed, 50/30A, dump station (not sewer at the site: derived sewer cleared), 7-night maximum, booked through City Hall/online form with sites picked first-come on arrival; pin on the gravel loop (Google pin 45 m S); not waterfront confirmed. Site count (20) not stated on the page, left as recorded.
flags: HOOKUPS: cleared the derived sewer: true. The city page prices '$25.00 per night which includes electricity, water, and sewer dump station' and lists a dump station with hours; a recent Google review says 'Quick and easy dump, but no hose for water unless you bring your own'. No page says sewer at the site.
SITES: the stored count 20 came from the old note; the city page gives no count. Left as recorded.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - imagery shows the RV loop (gravel oval) on open lawn west of the road; Hickory Creek runs ~120-150 m east beyond the road and a treed band. Pin 36.8820,-94.3710 sits at the loop's south end (Google pin 36.8816,-94.3711, 45 m S) - fine.
Phone 417-451-8050 (Neosho City Hall) confirmed on the page and Google.
